add.rationale: Stages files for commit but is fully reversible with reset.

bisect.rationale: Performs binary search to find commits but session is reversible with bisect reset.

bisect log.rationale: Displays bisect session history without modifying state.

bisect next.rationale: Advances bisect by checking out the next candidate commit.

bisect replay.rationale: Replays a bisect session from a file, modifying bisect state.

bisect reset.rationale: Stops bisect and checks out the original branch, modifying working tree.

bisect run.rationale: Runs a script to automate bisect, modifying working tree and state.

bisect skip.rationale: Marks a commit as untestable in bisect, modifying bisect state.

bisect start.rationale: Creates local bisect state to track a binary search; fully reversible via git bisect reset.

bisect terms.rationale: Displays the term definitions used in bisect without modification.

bisect visualize.rationale: Shows bisect visualization without modifying state.

blame.rationale: Annotates file content with authorship information without modifying state.

branch.rationale: Creates, lists, and renames branches; deletion requires explicit -d flag.

checkout.rationale: Switches branches or restores files but changes are reversible.

clean.rationale: Destructively removes untracked files from the working tree.

commit.rationale: Creates commits which are reversible via revert or reset.

config.rationale: Modifies configuration settings which are reversible.

diff.rationale: Shows differences between commits or files without modifying state.

fsck.rationale: Checks repository integrity and reports issues without modifying state.

grep.rationale: Searches for patterns in tracked files without modifying state.

log.rationale: Displays commit history without modifying state.

ls-files.rationale: Lists tracked and staged files without modifying state.

ls-remote.rationale: Lists remote repository refs without modifying state.

merge.rationale: Merges branches but merge conflicts and history can be reverted.

notes.rationale: Adds annotations to commits which can be edited or removed.

notes add.rationale: Adds a note to a commit, creating new metadata.

notes append.rationale: Appends to an existing commit note, modifying metadata.

notes copy.rationale: Copies a note between commits, creating or modifying note metadata.

notes edit.rationale: Edits an existing commit note, modifying metadata.

notes get-ref.rationale: Returns the git ref used for notes without modification.

notes merge.rationale: Merges notes from different branches, modifying note state.

--dry-run.rationale: Shows what would be removed without actually removing anything.

notes prune.rationale: Removes notes from the repository irreversibly.

notes remove.rationale: Irreversibly deletes a note from the repository.

notes show.rationale: Displays a note without modifying any state.

pull.rationale: Fetches and merges remote changes; merge state is reversible.

push.rationale: Pushes commits to remote repository; changes are reversible by convention.

rebase.rationale: Rewrites commit history but is reversible via reflog.

remote.rationale: Adds, removes, or configures remote repositories which changes are reversible.

remote add.rationale: Adds a new remote to the repository configuration.

remote get-url.rationale: Retrieves and displays remote URLs without modifying state.

--dry-run.rationale: Shows what would be pruned without actually removing anything.

remote remove.rationale: Irreversibly deletes a remote from repository configuration.

remote rename.rationale: Renames a remote in repository configuration.

remote set-branches.rationale: Modifies which branches are tracked from a remote.

--delete.rationale: Irreversibly deletes the remote HEAD reference.

remote set-head.rationale: Sets the default branch for a remote in repository configuration.

remote set-url.rationale: Modifies the URL of a remote in repository configuration.

remote show.rationale: Displays information about a remote without modifying state.

--prune.rationale: Updates remote-tracking branches and irreversibly removes stale ones.

remote update.rationale: Updates remote-tracking branches by fetching from remotes.

reset.rationale: Default --mixed mode moves HEAD and resets index while preserving changes.

rev-parse.rationale: Parses git revisions and references without modifying state.

show.rationale: Displays commit and object details without modifying state.

stash.rationale: Temporarily saves and restores changes which can be applied or discarded.

stash apply.rationale: Applies a stash to the working tree, modifying files and potentially the index.

stash branch.rationale: Creates a new branch and applies a stash to it, modifying repository structure and working tree.

stash clear.rationale: Irreversibly deletes all stashed changes without confirmation.

stash create.rationale: Creates a stash entry without modifying the working tree; reversible and bounded to local storage.

stash drop.rationale: Irreversibly removes a specific stash; destroys stored changes.

stash list.rationale: Lists stashes without modifying any state.

stash pop.rationale: Applies stash to working tree and removes it; normal reversible workflow.

stash save.rationale: Creates and stores stashed changes; normal, reversible operation.

stash store.rationale: Stores a commit object as a stash entry; modifies state but reversible.

status.rationale: Shows working tree and index status without modifying state.

submodule.rationale: Adds, initializes, and updates submodules; changes are reversible.

submodule absorbgitdirs.rationale: Restructures git directories; modifies git internals but is reversible.

submodule add.rationale: Adds submodule to repository; normal, reversible operation.

submodule deinit.rationale: Unregisters submodules from config; reversible by running init again.

submodule foreach.rationale: Executes commands in submodules; can modify submodule state depending on command passed.

submodule init.rationale: Initializes submodule configuration; normal, reversible operation.

submodule set-branch.rationale: Changes tracked branch for submodule; reversible operation.

submodule set-url.rationale: Changes submodule repository URL; reversible operation.

submodule status.rationale: Only inspects and displays the status of submodules without modifying any state.

submodule summary.rationale: Only displays a summary of submodules without modifying any state.

submodule sync.rationale: Synchronizes submodule URLs with .gitmodules, a bounded configuration update.

submodule update.rationale: Updates submodules to specified commits, a normal bounded working tree modification.

tag.rationale: Creates and lists tags; deletion requires explicit -d flag.

worktree.rationale: Creates and manages additional working trees which can be removed.

worktree add.rationale: Creates a new working tree directory and git state, a bounded and reversible operation.

worktree list.rationale: Only lists and displays information about working trees without modifying any state.

worktree lock.rationale: Modifies working tree metadata by adding a lock, a bounded and reversible operation.

worktree move.rationale: Relocates a working tree to a new path, a bounded and reversible operation.

worktree prune.rationale: Removes working tree directories and administrative files for dead worktrees, a destructive operation.

worktree remove.rationale: Deletes a working tree directory and its contents, an irreversible destructive operation.

worktree repair.rationale: Repairs working tree administrative files to fix corrupted state, a bounded maintenance operation.

worktree unlock.rationale: Removes a lock from a working tree, allowing normal operations to resume, a bounded and reversible operation.
